mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: the attributes window requires Fire_resistance

summary: At C step 318, debug Ctrl-X opens the Priestess's attributes window. The JavaScript attributes_enlightenment() preflight sees FIRE_RES and throws before the menu is created, while C emits the fire-resistance line and continues. The same C page then reaches shock resistance from blue dragon scale mail, electric item protection, telepathy from the pyramidal amulet, and warning from experience before the already-porting fast, luck, and prayer lines. Port the source-ordered item_resistance_message()/attributes_enlightenment() branches and their source-name helpers so the menu opens and the six remaining screens can continue.

source.branch: In an in-progress wizard/debug game with an unpolymorphed level-20 human Priestess, FIRE_RES and WARNING are intrinsic from the Priest role's experience table, SHOCK_RES is extrinsic from worn blue dragon scale mail, TELEPAT is extrinsic from a pyramidal amulet, and FAST is supplied by equipment. attributes_enlightenment() must append these conditional lines in C order; item_resistance_message(AD_ELEC, ...) must also append the 99% electric item-protection line naming the dragon mail, then preserve the existing magic-cancellation, luck, and can_pray output. The implementation must retain the same branches for heroes without these properties.

The smallest general implementation scope is the source-ordered item_resistance_message()/attributes_enlightenment() family in insight.c, with zap.c item_what() and attrib.c from_what() equipment-source wiring as dependencies. The first validation probe should replay this session through Ctrl-X and compare both attributes pages, RNG alignment, and the four post-menu steps; no session-specific condition should be introduced.
